entities.name: Bladewing brood
entities.description: Line of Shivan Dragons descended from Rorix Bladewing who oppose the Shivan Nation.

entities.name: Shivan Nation
entities.description: Dragon nation of Shiv built on equality of races.

entities.name: Rorix Bladewing
entities.description: Champion of Shiv who became a pit-fighter in Otaria, died in the Grand Coliseum and was reanimated as Bladewing the Risen.

entities.name: Verix Bladewing
entities.description: Descendant of Rorix who mourns his undead ancestor.

entities.name: Karox Bladewing
entities.description: Descendant of Rorix, mate of Verix.

entities.name: Tarox Bladewing
entities.description: Vicious dragon, son of Verix and Karox, who hopes to seize control of Darigaaz's nation.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out a large part of Shiv.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Dragon homeland partly phased out by Teferi.

events.summary: Teferi phased out a large chunk of Shiv and some dragons left to restore their race's pride.
events.quote: After Teferi phased out a large chunk of Shiv , some Shivan dragons journeyed away

events.summary: Rorix Bladewing died in the Grand Coliseum and was reanimated as Bladewing the Risen.
events.quote: He fought and died in the Grand Coliseum , but after his death, he was reanimated as Bladewing the Risen .

events.summary: Verix and Karox prepare to destroy their undead ancestor.
events.quote: are prepared to take down their undead ancestor for good

relations.note: Only faction to oppose its formation
relations.quote: The Bladewing brood were the only faction to oppose the Shivan Nation 's formation.
Tarox Bladewing is another descendant of Rorix Bladewing
